title: Tensor base changes of a directed union form a filtered ring colimit
statement: Let R be a commutative ring, A0 a Z-subalgebra of R, and B a commutative A0-algebra [lem-weil-pbc-algebra-tensor-pushout-universal-property]. Let P be a nonempty directed collection of Z-subalgebras A of R, each containing A0, which covers R elementwise. There is a small filtered category I, a diagram F:I to CommRing with a colimit [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], and a ring isomorphism colim F to R tensor over A0 B. Each stage is ring-isomorphic to A tensor over A0 B for an A belonging to P with its inclusion-induced A0-algebra structure. All types live in the common universe of R and B. There are no smoothness, normality or finite-type assumptions.

source.place: Tag 033C, third paragraph (the displayed tensor colimit); Tags 00CV and 05G3 (algebra tensor product universal property), with the directed-union universal property expanded

proof.text: Let I be the subalgebras A belonging to P with the inherited inclusion order. The nonempty directed hypotheses make it small filtered. Give every A the A0-algebra structure from A0 <= A. Define F(A)=A tensor over A0 B, with tensor maps induced by inclusions [lem-weil-pbc-algebra-tensor-map-ring-hom]. Define the cocone U with vertex R tensor over A0 B and tensor maps induced by inclusions A to R.
The covering hypothesis gives supremum A=top. Thus [lem-weil-pbc-directed-subalgebra-ring-colimit] makes the inclusion cocone for A to R colimiting.

For a ring cocone c on F, restriction to A tensor 1 gives a compatible family of ring maps out of A. The base colimit gives r:R to c.pt. Restriction to 1 tensor B gives b:B to c.pt independently of the stage, since any two stages have a common upper bound. The tensor balancing relation shows r and b agree on A0. Define the A0-algebra structure on c.pt using b and use [lem-weil-pbc-algebra-tensor-pushout-universal-property] to obtain a ring map m:R tensor B to c.pt.

The composites of m with the tensor coprojections agree with c on each tensor factor, so ringHom_ext proves factorization. For uniqueness, agreement on the R tensor 1 factor is tested in a stage containing its R element, using the cover; agreement on 1 tensor B is tested in any one stage. Tensor extensionality proves equality of the two maps.

The explicit cocone is colimiting. Choose HasColimit from it and compare it with the chosen categorical colimit to obtain the ring equivalence. Each stage is definitionally A tensor B; all types fit in the universe of R and B. No smoothness, normality or finite-generation hypothesis was used.
